scope: AI-001 server-core Gateway foundation, immutable route and invocation contracts, caller-selected single provider role, attempt UNKNOWN recovery, minimal input and server-adapters profile/egress/outside-transaction boundary

T-AI001-GATEWAY-MODULE-001.selector: AI-001 Gateway MODULE and deterministic AI_EVAL
assertions: an immutable fingerprinted manifest binds exact workload, route, adapter, model, deadlines, compatibility, input/output limits, cost ceiling and controlled-template reserve without latest or implicit defaults
a caller-selected primary or backup role can hand one response to the injected complete-candidate validator without letting the Gateway choose a downstream fallback policy
UNKNOWN is recorded once and replay of the same invocation/role/ordinal never dispatches that role again
two concurrent claims of the same invocation/role/ordinal dispatch one provider call while the loser returns RECOVER_EXISTING
provider unavailability and unreadable breaker admission return FALLBACK_REQUIRED so the caller can choose a later reviewed route or controlled template
high-risk admission invokes no ordinary provider
prepared input rejects account/user identity, root seed, raw score, source refs, raw note and Safety category keys before any adapter call
invalid provider raw output is rejected whole and never enters attempt reservation or completion metadata
every deterministic S-12 case uses synthetic prepared input and provider results with zero external network or real user data
UNKNOWN duplicate recovery, unavailable fallback, minimal-input rejection and high-risk zero-call paths assert each sample rather than selecting a best result
provider candidates pass the complete-candidate validator port and no candidate is repaired, spliced or partially retained
attempt evidence contains only opaque refs, route metadata, fingerprints, normalized outcome, usage and cost

T-AI001-GATEWAY-CONTRACT-001.selector: G12-P03 provider raw response and attempt metadata separation
assertions: a provider response with an otherwise usable field plus an unknown private source field is rejected whole
attempt reservation and completion retain only stable route metadata, fingerprints, outcome, usage and cost
the invalid raw provider body and source value do not enter attempt persistence inputs

T-AI001-ADAPTER-CONTRACT-001.selector: AI-001 provider adapter profile, egress and transaction contract
assertions: only the manifest-bound adapter/version, allowed Interactive or Background workload profile and exact egress target can reach the provider transport
an active database transaction, wrong runtime profile, expired deadline, cancellation or unlisted egress fails before transport
each adapter invocation calls transport at most once and preserves OUTCOME_UNKNOWN without same-role retry
usage and cost are non-negative normalized metadata and malformed provider results fail closed
arbitrary transport exceptions become a stable PROVIDER_NETWORK_ERROR without provider body, secret or error text
API imports of either server-core/ai-gateway or server-adapters/ai fail with BOUNDARY_CAPABILITY_API
server-core imports of provider SDK or concrete adapter runtime fail with BOUNDARY_CAPABILITY_SERVER_CORE
provider SDK imports outside packages/server-adapters/src/ai fail with BOUNDARY_PROVIDER_LOCATION
Interactive and Background may import the AI adapter while Restricted, Migration, API and client profiles cannot
